brief.text: Closed-End Funds represent a shared industry across the cluster listings, with BPRE, NXG, and CRAFX each recording purchases from three separate insiders. BORR generated the largest overall transaction total in the data at $57.1 million, whereas FUL drew the highest breadth of participant activity with eight distinct insiders buying shares. Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP) logged the second-largest cluster total at $22.0 million across seven insiders, a figure dominated by director James Healy, who individually accounted for $20.4 million of that total.
